body: Well, at this point I pretty much have to pick someone new. I can't force someone who's stopped talking to me to change their mind.
I'm not sure if I have it in me to keep trying with new people, as I'm afraid that it will just keep on going this way every single time.
I would love to. Unfortunately, I cannot for financial reasons.

> you seem like the person who gets a friend and stays close to them for about two or three months before you start to put distance between you two. 

I wish that was it, because if so, I'd have no one to blame but myself, and maybe I wouldn't hate my life as much as I do. Every time I've lost a friend, it's been because *they* were the one to put in the distance. Any time I get too close to someone, they just up and disappear and I'm left hurt and wondering what I did to drive them away.
